recommended_caption: Ask the insurer for the full valuation report before you accept a total loss offer.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Magnifying glass resting on an insurance policy beside cash and a toy car.
recommended_caption: Check your policy's coinsurance percentage and compare it to your building's current value.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Water spraying from a leaking pipe outdoors.
recommended_caption: Keep the failed part. It may be evidence if your insurer pursues the manufacturer or installer.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Closed sign hanging in a shop door window.
recommended_caption: Keep a timeline of when you closed, partly reopened, and fully reopened.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Rocks, mud, and debris left behind after a flood swept through a rural area.
recommended_caption: Describe mud damage accurately to your insurer: mudflow carried by water is treated differently from landslides.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Hailstones scattered across icy pavement after a storm.
recommended_caption: Photograph hailstones next to a ruler or coin to show their size.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Long crack running through a concrete wall.
recommended_caption: Photograph and measure cracks weekly. Growing cracks can be an early sinkhole sign.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Multi-story residential building with rows of balconies.
recommended_caption: Check your policy for loss assessment coverage before paying a special assessment.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Volunteer holding a box of donated items.
recommended_caption: Keep records showing donations were gifts, and report them to Social Security if you get SSI.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Worker renovating an interior wall with hand tools.
recommended_caption: Check permit records for major repairs before you buy or sell a storm-repaired home.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Man sitting at home reading through letters.
recommended_caption: Ask for the denial reason in writing, with the exact policy section it relies on.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Worker in a hard hat and safety vest holding a clipboard in a doorway.
recommended_caption: Check any adjuster's license with your state insurance department before you sign.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Roofer using a nail gun to install shingles on a house roof.
recommended_caption: Keep the final roofing invoice. It's how you collect held-back depreciation.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Top view of a desk with a laptop, insurance forms, and office supplies.
recommended_caption: Read your policy's appraisal section before making a written demand.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Black-and-white view of a neighborhood street with houses standing in floodwater.
recommended_caption: Photograph the water line inside and out. It helps separate flood damage from wind damage.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Three adults at an office table while one signs a document.
recommended_caption: Ask your mortgage servicer for its loss draft checklist on the first call.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Family at home signing a contract while a representative looks on.
recommended_caption: Read every contract fully, and get a copy, before work starts.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Hotel room with a made double bed.
recommended_caption: Call the hotel to confirm a room is available before you drive there.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Volunteers sorting boxes of donated supplies indoors.
recommended_caption: Serious Needs Assistance helps with urgent items like food, water, and medicine.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Worker in a hard hat and tool belt building the wooden frame of a house.
recommended_caption: ICC can pay up to $30,000 toward elevating or rebuilding to meet flood rules.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Construction professional in a hard hat reviewing plans on a clipboard at a job site.
recommended_caption: Ask your contractor for the permit number and check it with the building department.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Case worker reviewing documents with two people at an office table.
recommended_caption: Bring your FEMA number, insurance letters, and repair estimates to your first meeting.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Two volunteers sorting and packing food donations indoors.
recommended_caption: Local churches, charities, and volunteers pool resources through long-term recovery groups.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Two workers in hard hats doing carpentry on a wooden house frame.
recommended_caption: Real volunteer groups don't charge or ask for payment up front.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Open refrigerator stocked with groceries and drinks.
recommended_caption: Report food lost in an outage to your SNAP office within 10 days.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Electric meter and fuse box mounted on an outside wall.
recommended_caption: Call the utility before the shutoff date to ask about payment plans and medical protections.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Open circuit breaker panel with labeled breakers and wiring.
recommended_caption: Never touch the breaker panel if you're standing in water.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: One person wrapping a bandage around another person's hand outdoors.
recommended_caption: Clean cuts with soap and clean water, cover them, and check when you last had a tetanus shot.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Wooden radio sitting on a table at home.
recommended_caption: A battery or hand-crank weather radio still works when power and cell service fail.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Man sitting on a park bench texting on his phone.
recommended_caption: Text instead of calling when networks are overloaded. Texts often get through.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Brown and white cow standing in a green pasture.
recommended_caption: Mark or tag animals so they can be identified if they get loose in a disaster.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Solar panels mounted on a tiled house roof under a clear sky.
recommended_caption: Damaged solar panels can still produce electricity in daylight. Stay clear and call an installer.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Charging cable plugged into an electric car.
recommended_caption: Don't charge or drive an EV that sat in floodwater until it's inspected.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Nurse talking with a seated patient in a hospital room.
recommended_caption: Ask your dialysis center for its emergency plan and a backup center location.
